description: Indicateurs de condition des chaussées du réseau routier is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. La Ville de Montréal est responsable du développement, du maintien et de la gestion du réseau routier situé sur son territoire. La connaissance de la condition des chaussées est un élément important du processus de gestion et de détermination des besoins. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Auscultation, Chaussée, Condition, IRI, PCI. It offers 16 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, PDF, WEB. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
